verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents an SDK/API reference with a modular Python SDK. It covers instrumentation and querying and analyzing spans, plus client SDKs for syncing prompts. A documented remote MCP endpoint also lets agents search, query, and operate on projects, traces, datasets, experiments, prompts, and annotations. Missing for 10: no evidence of a documented REST/HTTP API reference or published OpenAPI spec (the probe found none at the arize.com paths it checked), and no independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end via the API.
